subject: Request: On-site hosting + limited audit window — Medisys deal
messages:
From: Elena Morris <emorris@medisyshealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: on-site hosting + audit window for Redwood Private

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Medisys has one final set of asks before procurement can sign: they require (1) the option to deploy a version of Redwood Private in their on-prem environment behind their own firewall (air-gapped), and (2) a 120-day audit window during onboarding where their internal auditors can run live tests against access controls and log exports.

We understand standard policy restricts live audits; can Redwood accommodate a limited-window live audit and an on-prem packaging path? If so, procurement wants pricing and any contract addenda they should expect. I'm attaching the updated SOW and our SOC questionnaire notes for context.

Attachements: Medisys_SOW_v2.pdf, SOC2-exception-request.docx

Best,
Elena
Director, IT Procurement
Medisys Health

---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: on-site hosting + audit window for Redwood Private

Marcus / Vivek — forwarding Medisys' asks. Summary: on-prem deployment (air-gapped) + 120-day live audit window during onboarding. They want pricing and contract language. They are a mid-enterprise healthcare customer, MRR potential ~55k/month, 12‑18 month commitment likely.

My read: engineering can ship an on-prem artifact but we need legal guardrails around data egress, KMS, and support scope. Security will balk at 120 days of live auditor access; 90 days is our usual compromise for on-prem carveouts. Procurement is pressing for a deeper discount if we allow live tests.

Proposed ask to Deal Desk / Execs: approve a one-time 15% contract-level discount and allow a 90-day live audit window (no persistent remote access; auditors local to customer site; us to provide redacted logs). If engineering requires a longer technical validation window, we can do a monitored 2-week validation followed by a 90-day audit window.

Can you both weigh in so I can respond to Elena with a firm position?

Thanks,
Priya
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: forwarded Medisys files

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: on-site hosting + audit window for Redwood Private

+1 on Priya's framing. A few operational asks before we take to Laura for exec sign-off:
- Confirm SLA expectations for the on‑prem deployment (we should require a 12‑month minimum support addendum and limit SLO-backed commits for on‑prem installs).
- Clarify the scope of the auditors (systems, only auth/logs, or full synthetic traffic tests?).
- Recommend commercial concession: 20% discount if they commit 18 months and sign a support addendum; otherwise cap at 15% for 12 months.

If Laura is comfortable with the risk matrix, I'm prepared to approve up to 15% now. Anything above should be routed to finance + CEO.

-Marcus
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Exec decision requested: Medisys on-prem + audit window + pricing

Laura — quick summary and recommendation for exec sign-off.

What Medisys is asking:
- On‑prem packaging of Redwood Private (air‑gapped option), deployed and managed by Medisys IT.
- Live audit access during onboarding for up to 120 days (they will run internal controls and live auth/trace tests).
- Request for 20% discount tied to an 18‑month commitment; fallback asks for 15% on 12 months.

Risks and mitigations:
- Security: extended live audits increase exposure. Proposed mitigation: allow a 90‑day audit window (local auditors only, no persistent remote shells), supply redacted logs and scripted test harnesses, require KMS with customer‑managed keys, and sign an audit playbook restricting scope.
- Support: require a paid support addendum for on‑prem installs with guaranteed engineer time and a 12‑month minimum term.
- Legal: include carveouts for incident response (no right to demand emergency remote debugging without legal signoff).

Commercial ask (my recommendation): Approve up to 15% discount for a 12‑month committed term with the mitigations above. Approve 20% only if customer signs 18 months + expanded support addendum and provides indemnities around auditor behavior.

Attachments: redlines_Medisys_20260221.pdf (highlights legal language), Medisys_SOW_v2.pdf, SOC2-exception-request.docx

Can you provide formal sign-off or escalate to the CEO if you need a higher concession?

Thanks — I’m standing by to finalize language and send a counter.

-Priya
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Exec decision requested: Medisys on-prem + audit window + pricing

Priya — thanks for the concise framing and the redlines. Approved with conditions below:

1) Commercial: approve up to 15% discount for a 12‑month committed term. Approve 20% only with an 18‑month term + prepayment of 6 months (or equivalent security).
2) Security/Audit: cap the live audit window at 90 days. Auditors must be on‑site and signed into our audit playbook (no production query/traffic injection allowed); we will supply redacted logs and a vetted test harness for their checks.
3) On‑prem: allow delivery of an on‑prem install artifact restricted to a hardened runtime image; no persistent remote maintenance unless under separate support addendum and with customer‑managed KMS.
4) Legal: require an indemnity clause for auditor actions and explicit carveouts for incident response. No unfettered source code access.

With these conditions, approve going back to Medisys and finalizing the SOW. If they insist on 120 days or a deeper discount without the 18‑month/6‑month prepay, escalate back to me and I will loop exec.

Laura Bennett
VP, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

-- Forwarded to Medisys --

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@medisyshealth.com>, procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: on-site hosting + audit window for Redwood Private

Hi Elena — thank you for the clear ask and the SOW. Laura (VP, Enterprise) has approved a path forward with the following contract and operational conditions: 

- Commercial: up to 15% discount for a 12‑month committed term. 20% requires 18 months + prepayment of 6 months.
- Audit window: we can accommodate a live audit window capped at 90 days. Auditors must be on site and follow our audit playbook; Redwood will provide redacted logs and a validated test harness. No traffic injection into production systems.
- On‑prem deployment: we can provide an air‑gapped/hardened runtime artifact; persistent remote maintenance will require a separate paid support addendum and customer‑managed KMS.

Next steps: please confirm if Medisys will accept the 90‑day window and 15%/12‑month commercial option. If yes, we will issue a revised SOW and redlined contract for signature (DocuSign link to follow). If you prefer the 20%/18‑month route, let us know and we will prepare the prepayment schedule and support addendum.

Attachments to follow: redlines_Medisys_20260221.pdf, updated SOW draft.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
